description: Seen 2026-09-03 on PR #223's run: OTP 27.3 and 29.0 jobs failed with ':dialyzer.run error: Old PLT file plts/dialyzer.plt' immediately after a cache hit, while 28.3 passed with a cache from the same 2026-08-28 save. elixir_ci.yaml keys the PLT cache as ${{runner.os}}-${{matrix.elixir}}-${{matrix.otp}}-plts-v3-${{hashFiles('**/mix.lock')}} — matrix.otp is '27.3', not the resolved patch release, so a runner-image OTP patch bump invalidates the PLT format without invalidating the key. Fix: include setup-beam's resolved otp-version/elixir-version outputs in the key (or bump plts-v3 and add the outputs). Immediate remediation already done: deleted cache ids 7106643988/7106652589 and reran.

title: CI: PLT cache key omits resolved OTP patch version, so runner image updates poison dialyzer PLTs
